discovery_notes: First pass of lic-other 2015; 29 standard search-snippet queries, no prior lic/2015 keys existed. Found Marvel SDCC 2015 (28) and NYCC 2015 (22+Coulson) Skottie Young lines, Star Wars Celebration Anaheim pin program (45) incl. exhibitor pins (Samsonite, Anovos, EFX, ThinkGeek, PPW) and a ThinkGeek exclusive. No dated 2015 ArtLand, Acme, Hot Topic, Her Universe, Funko, EE, BoxLunch or Loungefly pins found.
